changelog: The update details popup and Dashboard → Updates no longer call Stockroom untested on a later point release of the WordPress branch it was tested with. The release manifest names a branch (7.1), and WordPress compares whole versions, so 7.1.4 read as newer than 7.1: the popup warned "This plugin has not been tested with your current version of WordPress" and Updates showed "Compatibility: Unknown". Stockroom now reports the running version when it is in that branch, as WordPress.org does; a newer branch (7.2) still gets the warning.

The update details popup shows each changelog line as it is written. A line holding an HTML entity, such as the code for an apostrophe in 1.2.1's line about plain-text emails, showed the character instead of the code. Every ampersand in a line is now shown as typed.

The French cart message for a deck that can't be made in the quantity ordered says "only" again: « Pour le moment, nous ne pouvons fabriquer que 1 × … », where it read « nous pouvons fabriquer 1 × … ».
Tests for a restore and a refund of a line whose variation is in the Trash: its ready-made units go back to its shelf with a Restore or Refund entry, not a write-off, as 1.2.1 said.

Ten files under src/ lost casts, guards and steps that mutation testing showed changed nothing, such as the hold's sort and de-duplication of the part ids it locks, which PartRepository::lockForUpdate() already does. Stockroom behaves exactly as in 1.2.1. The same work added tests that the takes and holds lock their counts before changing them, and the integration mutation score went from 81% to over 99%.
